newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks end up, look for guidance.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks end up, look for guidance.

text.p: 1431 GMT GMT - South African stocks end up but sharply off day's highs as market hunts for guidance following Wednesday's budget. Most dealers eyeing international markets with a focus on Wall Street. Strong bond and currency markets providing support in healthy volumes. Golds weak on bullion price.
* All-share index ends up 3.7 points at 7,171.6 as industrials gain 5.5 points to 8,373.7. Golds index sheds 17.9 points to 1,429.6.
* Iscor ends up five cents at 395 cents and De Beers unchanged at 161.00 rand.
